item.title: PSA - Scam Links are making the rounds on imgur
item.description: Warn-a-Brotha For a week in some comments there appears links to a website called onlinevideos(dot)link. This is a scam/fraud/spam The posters are often times ancient accouns (10-12 years) have almost no post history (likely wiped) and where last active around 20 days to appear legit. They copy a post from there that included a youtube link (or any link i think) and just replace it with their onlinevideo link. The Domain is only 13 days old and the website does a lot of shady stuff in the background (and in the forground if you dont run any protection in your browser). They also have an up- & downvote brigade to push their own posts and downvote warnings. BE VIGILANT - DO NOT CLICK ANY ONLINEVIDEO LINKS - Warn others - report the post and downvote it. @imgur just block any posts with that url

item.title: West Virginia pastor rejects food over LGBQT support. Now his food bank is empty.
item.description: Alvin Christian is the man behind God’s Store House Food Bank in Bluefield, West Virginia, a city located in the southernmost part of the state. Since 2023, the pastor has helped feed up to 800 families a day. If you’ve ever worked at a food pantry, you know donations can come from individuals, larger food banks, or local businesses with excess product they can’t sell anymore. As recently as last week, Christian was letting supporters know everything he had in store for them. But he recently filmed a video showing viewers that his freezers were completely empty. There was no food coming in, and therefore no food going out. In the now-deleted reel, Christian explained that there were outlets trying to give him the resources he needed… he just refused to take them. Because, after doing his own research, he found out those groups worked with or supported LGBTQ people. A copy of the video was preserved by Facebook user nes.quick.737, who said the pastor “would rather let his people STARVE than to accept food for the pantry from the LGBTQ community.” https://www.friendlyatheist.com/p/west-virginia-pastor-rejects-food

item.title: GovBrief Today #551
item.description: Kansas beat the anti-abortion movement twice in two days. On Monday, Judge Christopher Jayaram issued a 260 page ruling that the state cannot force women to wait 24 hours or answer questions about their finances or their reasons before ending a pregnancy. He wrote that under the Kansas Constitution's guarantee of bodily autonomy, his ruling was not even a close call. Hours later he was sworn onto the Kansas Supreme Court. On Tuesday, voters crushed a ballot amendment its backers planned to use to ban abortion by remaking that court. The ruling permanently blocks enforcement. Kansas can still appeal, but that appeal goes to a state Supreme Court that has already ruled bodily autonomy fundamental. The restrictions are gone as long as Kansans keep guarding the court that killed them, which is exactly what they did on Tuesday.
